desc: Parse input (N, M, edges) and build adjacency list storing (neighbor, Z) for each edge.

BFS/DFS over the graph to assign `offset[node]` (starting from 0 for each component root), detect contradictions (including self-loops where Z != 0), and group nodes by component id, collecting their offset values.
If any contradiction is found, print `-1` and exit.
For each component, build a binary trie (e.g., using arrays for child indices and counts) and insert all its offset values.
Implement recursive DP on the trie that returns minimal sum of lower bits and also records the optimal bit decisions, yielding the best constant `x` for the component.
Compute final `A_i = x xor offset[i]` for each node using its component's best `x`.
